args.prompt:
Draw EXACTLY SIXTEEN newly drawn complete full-body sprites: FOUR equal columns by FOUR equal rows, transparent RGBA sprite atlas, detailed crisp pixel-art adult game proportions. Attached NEW native32 atlas is the sole appearance reference; retain its corrected version and wardrobe but draw16 NEW poses. Chris Redfield, default BSAA field outfit in Resident Evil5(2009): muscular adult man, short brown hair, light stubble, olive tactical vest/webbing over a LIGHT TAN short-sleeved collared shirt, small BSAA shoulder patch, exposed muscular forearms, dark charcoal cargo trousers, brown-black tactical boots, black fingerless gloves, utility belt and visible M92F thigh holster. No later black turtleneck, winter coat, bionic armor or transformed form.
Equipment: Ordinary sidearm is the physical black M92F handgun. Satellite Laser uses the separate handheld L.T.D. laser TARGET DESIGNATOR: compact grey military targeting device with optical sight and a tiny red lens, physically held in both hands; it is NOT an arm cannon or laser-emitting body. The orbital strike arrives from outside the screen in runtime, so do not draw a giant beam or explosion from Chris, his hand or the device.
All figures side/three-quarter generally facing RIGHT. One shared body scale across the source, naturally shorter crouches remain shorter. Leave15% transparent gap around entire body and all props, inside every cell. No text, borders, grid, floor, painted shadows, scenery, extra people or victims. Entire hands, face, hair, boots and weapon must remain visible.
ROW1 IDLE: (1) relaxed alert standing with weapon safely down/holstered, (2) shift weight backward and scan ahead, (3) adjust belt or sling with free hand while knees soften, (4) low ready stance with shoulders and elbows shifted. Four different shoulder/arm/leg drawings.
ROW2 RUN: four real running cycle positions, weapon kept safely down and controlled: (1) right foot extended forward and opposite elbow forward, (2) compressed passing stride with feet close to torso, (3) left foot forward with right shoulder leading, (4) airborne stride with legs separating and torso leaning. No severed or extra limb; full feet stay inside the cell.
ROW3 BASIC Tir du M92F de Chris: physical black M92F semiautomatic handgun only. (1) draw handgun with bent knees, (2) raise two-handed aim RIGHT with both feet planted, (3) small real shot recoil with elbows flexing and tiny flash at barrel opening, (4) lower handgun and recover balanced stance. No L.T.D. or Satellite Laser in this row. Four truly different torso/arm/leg positions, not merely flash changes.
ROW4 HIT/RECOVERY alive: (1) startled backward recoil with guarding forearm, (2) deeper lean back with one heel raised, (3) low crouch recovering with shoulders forward, (4) return to alert standing guard with BOTH COMPLETE FEET including heels/toes/soles clearly visible above a wide transparent bottom margin. No blood, death or body injury.
Final check: EXACT4 complete rows x4 full anatomical drawings=16, no missing/blank/duplicated cell. All figures including last row fourth pose have complete feet; do not crop at ankle or waist. Keep correct source-version costume and basic weapon.
